notes:
SIMD TEST Vault on Robinhood Chain (4663): a test of the SIMD relaunch for the SIMD TEST 2 - DO NOT BUY token launch, not the real thing. Deploy only SIMDVault, with no constructor arguments and no ETH. Its constructor creates the other three contracts of the suite (SimdAirdrop, JobsVault, HolderRewards) and exposes them as the immutable getters simdAirdrop(), jobsVault() and holderRewards(), so they are not listed here: a separate copy would not be linked to this vault. No constructor calls an existing contract. There is no owner, admin, upgrade or pause and no $owner argument. These are constants: dev and marketing wallet (both 0xdfa1f1f6feaa04f7874eff0b7754b7ffaebd8bc0), IMD 0x5f7bb59365ce557c26dbcaa4ee9d39a4b95b7127, Intake 0xa43e6f75ee006411f79ac1c84120606c2330de82, HOOK launch factory 0xa25b02a1e93903b790e6aaf7da1b8b8d50294645, oracle signer 0x5598aa9146215bc13eb26f2c692ad1461fd32982 and burn address 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD.

SIMDVault: the dev wallet calls launch(body) once, paying the live launch.open@launch-1 price from the vault's own IMD, which makes the vault the launch's requester. The dev wallet then calls bindLaunch(launchNumber, token) once; it needs the vault as requester, a launch above 3076 and a non-IMD token whose pool pairs with IMD, and it passes the token to HolderRewards and JobsVault. Anyone can call distribute() after binding, the first time at once and then every 7 days. It tries claimFees, splits the whole IMD balance 40% HolderRewards, 25.72% JobsVault, 17.14% dev, 17.14% marketing (dust stays), sends the whole launched-token balance to the burn address and pushes native ETH to marketing. A failed claim or rejected native push blocks nothing.

HolderRewards: each deposit opens an epoch and buys oracle.request@oracle-1 from its pot, asking for a Merkle root of IMD allocations pro rata to holders' balances. Pools, the PoolManager, the factory, the four contracts, the zero and burn addresses are excluded. Only Intake can deliver the answer, and it must carry the oracle signer's attestation. A pot too small to pay carries to the next deposit; anyone can retry a failed request after 1 day from the epoch's pot. claim(epoch, amount, proof) pays once per epoch per holder and never beyond the pot. After 28 days claims close and anyone can roll exactly pot - claimed into the current epoch.

JobsVault: holds its weekly IMD and pays job.open@job-1 only, with no withdraw of IMD. A wallet with at least 1,000,000 launched tokens staked in the vault can call requestJob(body) once per 24 hours.

SimdAirdrop: fixed list, root 0xe1fc34a5aee64c3cd01e62934929bc57511b5718c2f5ae80072ae25045e50cb4, total weight 633028988023500000000000000, 457 wallets. Anyone can call bind(launchNumber) once, after the vault's binding, for a launch above 3076 with the vault as requester, an IMD pair and at least the total weight held. Listed wallets claim their own pro-rata share once for 30 days; afterwards anyone can burn what is left.

Where the accepted source refines the brief: JobsVault eligibility is a stake held in the vault through stake and unstake, locked 24 hours by each job, not a spot balance, because a spot balance can be lent between wallets within one transaction; stakes count as balance in the holder snapshot. The holder snapshot is 8 L2 blocks before the deposit block, because the oracle refuses a window fewer than five blocks deep. bindLaunch also refuses launches at or below 3076 and non-IMD pairs, and SimdAirdrop.bind also requires the vault's matching binding.

After launch: fund the vault with IMD for the launch price; the launch body must send the remainder to simdAirdrop(); then launch, bindLaunch, bind and weekly distribute.
